selected_surface_root.algorithm: sha256 of compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON plus terminal LF after removing selected_surface_root

capability_probe.input: closed enums for the selected methods, notifications, callbacks, and transports
capability_probe.available_when: the exact member exists in the accepted schema tree and its owning compatibility and session preconditions hold

requests.thread/start: create the one server-owned thread required for a new typed session
requests.thread/resume: reattach to an existing thread after host or transport replacement
requests.thread/read: recover a current typed thread projection after reconnect or missed events
requests.thread/list: perform bounded typed discovery when the caller does not retain a thread identifier
requests.turn/start: submit work within an initialized thread without raw RPC
requests.turn/steer: add caller input to an active turn through the official typed operation
requests.turn/interrupt: request remote turn termination; local call cancellation is not equivalent
requests.review/start: start the official domain-neutral review operation without a raw method escape

notifications.error: surface structured terminal or nonterminal server failure
notifications.warning: surface a nonfatal server warning without exposing content logs
notifications.deprecationNotice: surface protocol currentness evidence needed for compatibility review
notifications.thread/status/changed: track the current lifecycle state of the active thread
notifications.turn/started: attribute subsequent items and deltas to the active turn
notifications.turn/completed: provide the authoritative terminal result for a turn
notifications.turn/diff/updated: provide the typed cumulative file-change projection
notifications.turn/plan/updated: provide the typed cumulative plan projection
notifications.item/started: establish an item before item-scoped deltas arrive
notifications.item/completed: close item-scoped streaming and expose its final projection
notifications.item/agentMessage/delta: stream the primary typed assistant-message output
notifications.item/plan/delta: stream plan-item text before the cumulative plan update
notifications.item/reasoning/summaryTextDelta: stream the official summary channel without raw response events

callbacks.item/commandExecution/requestApproval: return caller policy for a command request without package-selected approval
callbacks.item/fileChange/requestApproval: return caller policy for a file-change request without package-selected approval
callbacks.item/tool/requestUserInput: return caller-supplied answers to the official typed question callback

transports.owned-stdio: own one local app-server process with deterministic cleanup
transports.unix-socket: attach to an explicitly addressed local app-server connection without process ownership
transports.injected-byte-channel: test and embed the same RPC/session behavior without hidden transport creation
